# Ionic Core selected components

- Package: `@ionic/core` 9.0.7, MIT
- Included custom elements: `ion-segment`, `ion-segment-button`, `ion-label` and their required runtime.
- Built as one minified classic-script bundle with esbuild 0.28.2 so the HTML prototype does not require a CDN, a module loader, or a development build step.
- Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ionic/core/v/9.0.7
- License: see `LICENSE`.
- The rest of Ionic Core is not vendored. Keep the bundle limited to components that have passed prototype-specific interaction and browser review.
